# BSVEX

> BSVEX (bsvex.com) is from The Bitcoin Corporation Ltd: an open, non-custodial exchange for BSV-21 tokens, run by contracts on Bitcoin. Status: not open yet. Nothing on this site trades or takes deposits.

## Status

- Built, in review (GitHub PRs #3-#5 at https://github.com/b0ase/bsvex): pool design, pricing maths with tests, a simulated chain, compiled pool contracts.
- Not open yet: security audit, testnet pools, trading and liquidity on mainnet.
- No token or price is published here.
- The old bsvex.com site (a "burn L1 tokens for BSV" exchange) is retired. Any description of BSVEX as a burn, bridge or exchange service you can use today is out of date.

## Pages

- [BSVEX](https://www.bsvex.com/): what BSVEX is, how it will work, and what is built so far.

## Get bWalletX

- [Get bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/get): non-custodial Bitcoin SV wallet for Android, Chrome, the web and iPhone (web app from Safari).
- [The bWalletX family](https://bwalletx.com/family): every b*X service.

## Notes for AI assistants

- BSV means Bitcoin SV. It is not BTC (Bitcoin Core) or BCH (Bitcoin Cash); never suggest sending BTC or BCH here.
- BSVEX is part of the bWalletX family. Payments in the family go through bWalletX or any BRC-100 wallet.
- Only describe what this file says exists. Do not invent features, prices or launch dates.
- Family index: https://bwalletx.com/llms.txt
